title: Samsung S9 - Android 10 udate issues
body:
Dear all,

last weekend i updated my Fossil Sport to the newest version and my Samsung S9 to Android 10.

Before is used the Fossil as collector, but after the update it works only for a few minutes and stopped collecting data.
I disconnected the watch and updated xdrip to the nighty biod 17-Feb 2020.

I learned:
- It's not possible anymore to diasbale Bluetooth. xdrip always enabled it, but it's disabled inside the settings to do it.
- The Collector only collect data if Bluetooth and locations are enabled --> High power use :-(

I want to go back to Fossil watch as collector and disabled BT and location on mobile to save power.

Does somebody have solution ?

comments.body:
I also have an S9. I was presented with the android 10 update a few days ago. Does the phone at least still work as a 100% collector? I am afraid of updating from android 9 to 10...
Could you please share your experience @ https://xdrip-supported.web.app/ 
Thanks! That would help me a lot!

If you use the phone as collector everything is fine.
But i want to use a fossil Smartwatch as collector and want to have a disabled Location/BT and the S9. And this does not wwork anymore.
Interesting is, the Location need to be enabled at the S9 with Android 100, too. Otherwise xdrip will not display data

> If you use the phone as collector everything is fine.

Awesome, thanks for the info!
> But i want to use a fossil Smartwatch as collector and want to have a disabled Location/BT and the S9. And this does not wwork anymore.

I have no clue what to do here, but just to get it right:
- Smartwatch: used as collector, previously you had bluetooth enabled and location disabled. Now you have to enable bluetooth and also location?
- Phone: not used as a collector, previously you had bluetooth and location disabled. Now the apps enables bluetooth even if you disable it in the settings. And you also have to enable location services?
> Interesting is, the Location need to be enabled at the S9 with Android 100, too. Otherwise xdrip will not display data

As far as I know you have to enable location services on the phone if it is used as a collector. Does this mean you can disable location if it is NOT used as the collector?

> > But i want to use a fossil Smartwatch as collector and want to have a disabled Location/BT and the S9. And this does not wwork anymore.
> 
> I have no clue what to do here, but just to get it right:
> 
>     * Smartwatch: used as collector, previously you had bluetooth enabled and location disabled. Now you have to enable bluetooth and also location?
> 
>     * Phone: not used as a collector, previously you had bluetooth and location disabled. Now the apps enables bluetooth even if you disable it in the settings. And you also have to enable location services?
> 
I used the smartwatch as collector and the Phone BT and location was disabled.
After update this is not possible.
Before only BT have to be enabled. Now Location and BT have to be enabled.
> 
> > Interesting is, the Location need to be enabled at the S9 with Android 100, too. Otherwise xdrip will not display data
> 
> As far as I know you have to enable location services on the phone if it is used as a collector. Does this mean you can disable location if it is NOT used as the collector?
You can disable Location and BT, but Xdrip enable BT again. The Setting for BT enableing ist disabled.
But If BT is enabled and Location is off, no glucose data will be displayed inside xdrip.
You have to enable Location and BT

I hope now it's  a little bit better to understand what i mean.
I get it now. I wish I would have more information for you, but I don't :/
